description: The writing window may tell the app it has saved before quitting, read/write/stat only the Markdown and .kanso files the person handed this install (Finder, Dock, open -a, File > Open…, a save panel: src-tauri/src/files.rs refuses anything else, including symlinks to other kinds of file) and give such a grant up, ask for a save panel, make the app the default for .md on request, and drag / zoom the window from its header. No other core, file system, shell or opener access: downloads and outside links are handled natively.
